name: Total JavaScript Bundle
message: Total gzip size of all client JavaScript chunks. Next.js 16 with Turbopack writes every chunk flat into .next/static/chunks.

name: CSS Bundle
message: CSS bundle size. Consider purging unused Tailwind classes and optimizing critical CSS.

name: Runtime script exec time
message: Execution time of the Turbopack runtime chunk. Keep under 500ms. Current target allows for CI environment variations.
